This is a local FastAPI application that manages persistent domain resources through REST endpoints.
Apply the shared authorization, validation, controlled-error, and transaction conventions specified for the endpoint.

requirement_context.formal_requirement: The system shall expose POST /properties to an authenticated user or admin, accepting JSON title, address, property_type, price_cents; it shall validate property fields and creator ownership, create the Property and required relations, perform the creation atomically, be non-idempotent, and return 201 with Location, and emit only 201, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

relevant_domain_invariants.requirement: All resource ids are immutable positive integers; non-positive path and referenced ids are treated as not found.
Properties have title 5..160, address 5..200, price_cents 1000..2000000000, property_type enum, and creator agent.
Agents have unique email, license_code, and active boolean.

generation_constraints: Return exactly four fenced Python sections named schemas_code, orm_model_code, controller_code, and route_code.
Implement controller_contract as behavior, not comments.
Do not implement narrower filters than controller_contract scopes.
Do not invent tables, foreign keys, status values, owner fields, or controller calls outside this contract.
